manifest.name: Stripe Webhook Failure Recovery
manifest.description: Diagnose and recover from webhook delivery failures with clear checkpoints and verification.

inputs.name: endpointUrl
inputs.description: Public webhook endpoint to validate reachability.

inputs.name: stripeSecret
inputs.description: Stripe signing secret for verifying payloads.

sideEffects: May replay webhooks from Stripe CLI
May pause downstream job queues during recovery

steps.title: Verify endpoint reachability
steps.summary: Confirm the webhook endpoint is reachable and returns a 2xx status.
checklist: Ping the endpoint from the Stripe CLI

annotations.message: Endpoint returned intermittent 500 responses during peak traffic.
annotations.author: stitch-ops

steps.title: Verify webhook signature
steps.summary: Ensure the signing secret matches Stripe and signatures validate.
checklist: Fetch latest signing secret from vault
Rotate secret if mismatch is detected

annotations.message: Secret rotated last week; ensure staging/prod values are aligned.
annotations.author: stitch-ops

steps.title: Replay missed events
steps.summary: Replay failed webhooks and monitor downstream processing.
checklist: Queue replay batch in Stripe CLI

annotations.message: Replay only the last 2 hours while backlog stabilizes.
annotations.author: stitch-ops

steps.expectedOutcome: All missed events processed without errors.
